claims.text: The hypo2path model's success is attributed to its training objective of predicting entire hypernym paths rather than just direct hypernyms, which enhances model strength.
The use of LSTM-based sequence-to-sequence architecture with attention mechanisms in hypo2path contributes to its effective learning and performance.
The model's ability to generate valid paths in WordNet, regardless of direct hypernym accuracy, indicates robustness in path generation.
